test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Easy money

options.text: Collect someone’s cash for them easily
Work hard to earn a large salary without telling anyone
Have no difficulty in collecting money that is due
Make money without much effort, maybe illegally

solution:
The correct answer is **"Make money without much effort, maybe illegally"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the given idiom* "Easy money"- money obtained by dubious means or for little work*.

 
 
• For example- Schools facing tight budgets see corporate sponsorship as easy money.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. "Make money without much effort, maybe illegally"**
